title: This summer was hot. August shattered global heat records
content: Scientists say that August was the hottest month ever recorded globally. In the U.S., summer temperatures also shattered heat records.

title: Lawsuit challenges intimidation of DHS observers across the country
content: The sweeping lawsuit brought by Common Cause argues federal agencies are illegally surveilling and intimidating people who try to peacefully observe federal immigration enforcement activity.

title: A fossil feather from the age of dinosaurs may explain why only some birds survived
content: An extremely well preserved fossil feather could reveal why some birds survived the dinosaur-killing asteroid, and others did not.

title: How the WNBA became a political prop in the culture wars
content: Sports journalist Sabreena Merchant says culture war issues related to race and trans athletes threaten to overshadow exceptional play on the WNBA court.

title: Barbara Keating died in the 9/11 attack. She's finally being laid to rest
content: Barbara Keating died aboard one of the planes that hijackers slammed into the World Trade Center. Her remains were finally identified last year, and her family is gathering for a long-delayed funeral.

title: Elon Musk threatens to sue over Gibney documentary's "space lasers" claim
content: The tech billionaire's attorney has put documentarian Alex Gibney and his production company on legal notice, claiming the Oscar-winning director defamed Musk in his nearly four-hour documentary.

title: 'I've never seen anything like this' -- A U.S. doctor treats Ebola's youngest victims
content: Dr. Rupa Narra is a U.S. pediatrician who arrived in the Democratic Republic of Congo to help care for stricken children. Nothing could have prepared her for what she'd face.

title: How did 9/11 reshape national security?
content: Sept. 11 represented a new kind of national security threat, and a new national security architecture was created to confront it.

title: Trump promises Americans $5K if GOP wins. And, Kirk supporters reflect on his death
content: President Trump tries to incentivize voters by promising $5,000 to Americans if the GOP wins the midterms. And, young conservatives reflect on the party one year after Charlie Kirk's death.

title: One year after Charlie Kirk's death, Turning Point USA faces an uncertain future
content: The death of Charlie Kirk was seen as a rallying call for young conservatives. But as his supporters reflect on the past year, some paint a more complicated picture of the organization he left behind.
